identity.name: Crossref
identity.description: DOI registration agency for most scholarly publishers; its REST API serves the publisher-deposited metadata for every Crossref DOI (titles, authors, venue, dates, licences, full-text links, funders, references where open).

asserted.rationale: The registration record behind most journal DOIs, so it is the most reliable source for bibliographic facts (who published what, where, when, under which licence URL). Metadata is deposited by publishers and varies in completeness; it points to the article rather than holding it. Tier 2 as an index; the article of record is the publisher's.

jurisdiction.notes: Global literature; the pilot filters to US single-family housing at query time.

artifacts.notes: Work metadata: DOI, title, author, container-title, issued, publisher, license[], link[] (text-mining URLs), reference[] (when open), abstract (JATS, when deposited).

content.notes: link[] entries with intended-application text-mining are the publisher's own TDM URLs; they still need the publisher's entitlement.

auth.notes: Keyless public pool. The polite pool (mailto param or UA contact) would use credential_ref scholarly_contact_email; not injected by the CLI for keyless methods. Metadata Plus (paid token) is out of scope.

limits.notes: Public pool: provider-documented 5 req/s and 1 concurrent request (polite pool 10 req/s, 3 concurrent). Crossref reports its live limit in x-rate-limit-* headers (not captured by the probe whitelist).

robots.tos_notes: Crossref metadata is offered without restriction (facts are not copyrightable); abstracts deposited by publishers may carry publisher copyright.

endpoints.name: works-query
endpoints.description: Bibliographic query over works with filters; cursor-paged deep paging.

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text query over all metadata fields.

params.name: query_bibliographic
params.description: query.bibliographic: title/author/year-style matching (best for citation strings).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Deep paging: * on the first request; the CLI follows message.next-cursor.

pagination.notes: Cursors expire after 5 minutes idle; a page with fewer items than rows is the last.

endpoints.name: work-by-doi
endpoints.description: The registration record for one DOI.

params.name: doi
params.description: Bare DOI; the CLI URL-encodes the slash (%2F), which Crossref accepts.

response.notes: 404 means the DOI is not a Crossref DOI (it may be DataCite or another agency).

best_for: Authoritative bibliographic facts for a DOI (title, authors, venue, dates, publisher)
Licence URLs and publisher text-mining links for a DOI (license[], link[])
Resolving messy reference strings to DOIs (query.bibliographic)
Second discovery index to cross-check OpenAlex recall on the pilot topic

query_shapes.recipe: query= words + filter=from-pub-date:2015,type:journal-article; select= to trim; cursor=* for deep paging.
query_shapes.example: --param query='electrical panel capacity heat pump' --param rows=20

query_shapes.recipe: query_bibliographic=<full citation string>, rows=3; accept only a hit whose title and year match.
query_shapes.example: --param query_bibliographic='Assessing electrification readiness in U.S. single-family homes electrical panel capacities 2025' --param rows=3

pitfalls: Relevance search is broad: many hits are loosely related; filter by type and date and read titles before fetching.
Abstracts are present only when the publisher deposited them, as JATS XML strings.
license[] describes what the publisher asserted at deposit; it is not an OA guarantee and may carry an embargo start date.
Public-pool limits are low (1 concurrent request); never parallelise against it.
Only Crossref DOIs resolve here; DataCite DOIs (datasets, some reports) 404.
guidance.llm_notes: Use to confirm bibliographic facts and licences before a paper enters the UPC corpus; cite the article, not Crossref.

resolution.notes: Follow https://doi.org/<DOI> (or message.resource.primary.URL) to the publisher's version of record.

discovery.discovered_via: model knowledge (Hermes scholarly registry pass), cross-checked against pdf-harvest references

optional_credentials.notes: Polite pool (10 req/s, 3 concurrent); awaiting Ellie's choice of contact email. Not injectable by the reference CLI for a keyless method.

officiality.basis: Registration agency; holds publisher-deposited metadata about works published elsewhere.
officiality.notes: For the DOI-to-publisher mapping itself Crossref is the registration of record.

completeness.notes: Exhaustive for Crossref-registered DOIs by construction; it does not cover DataCite DOIs or undeposited grey literature.
